description: Chewy (US) item tracker: for 1-10 Chewy item IDs (the number after /dp/ in a chewy.com URL) returns name, brand, price, strike-through price, Autoship price and discount, per-unit price, in-stock / discontinued flags, shipping timeframe, GTIN, rating and rating count, active promotions, size/flavor variants with their prices and stock, and key attributes. From the GraphQL API chewy.com's product pages use; no keyword search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated Chewy item IDs or chewy.com product URLs, 1 to 10, e.g. 323026 (required)
